reasoning_content:
MapServer 7.6 does not expand `${FOOVAR}` even when FOOVAR is set in the environment. Interesting — MapServer doesn't expand environment variables in mapfiles at all (this behavior was added in MapServer 8.x? Actually, environment variable expansion in mapfiles has historically not been a MapServer feature — it's something that gets done at deploy time via config management. For example, Docker does envsubst). In other words, in the reference Docker deployment, envsubst or some similar mechanism must be doing the substitution at startup.

Wait — but the CONFIG entries use `$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID` without braces. If MapServer doesn't expand these either, then the AWS settings will be the literal string "$AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID"… Let me check how the reference Docker deployment handles this. Let's look at the xplan-services-wms Dockerfile and related resources.
